saved_record_diagnosis.html_paragraph: A generic conventional conjunctive planner, scanning all \(2{,}921\) admitted licences, proposed a finite dependency cluster for incidence transport from \(u=v\), \(v=w\), and \(\operatorname{Incident}(C,u)\) to \(\operatorname{Incident}(C,w)\). The advised lane completed in \(21\) attempts and \(1.3783\) search seconds; its saved independent certificate accepts all \(24\) primitive rows and the exact point tiling. The essential closure has \(3\) hypotheses, \(2\) equality-substitution licences and \(4\) modus-ponens steps; \(15\) unused axiom tiles fill the boundary. All \(6\) offered preferred keys were selected, while \(15\) branches used canonical fallback. Construction cost \(0.01186\) seconds and complete advice calls cost \(0.22631\) seconds. The matched canonical lane remains UNKNOWN after \(94\) attempts at the \(2{,}000\)-event ceiling. This is one pilot with no semantic trajectory replay, statistical advantage, essential Hilbert-axiom reasoning, learned-cluster admission or RL credit.
